en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a newly built suburban housing estate surrounded by fields and forest. The development consists of multiple mid‑rise apartment blocks arranged in curved and zigzag patterns around open courtyards, with a few taller towers and scattered low buildings that may be schools or community facilities. At the bottom of the image there is an older area of detached houses with gardens, and a wide road intersection leads toward the estate. The setting looks like a planned mid‑20th‑century residential district on the edge of a European city.
